_readme: Atlas's stock spoken lines. Edit freely: the dashboard re-reads this file on the next turn. Lines are dealt like a shuffled deck, so none repeats until the rest of its group has played. Put a line in 'retired' to stop it being said without deleting it. Keep lines short and plain: no *, _, # or backticks.
ack_question: Now there's a thing. Let me see.
Bear with me, I'll find out.
Let me have a proper look.
ack_task: Your wish, my command. Within reason.
ack_lookup: Let me go and find out.
long_wait: Bear with me, this one's chewy.
Still going. It's thinking quite hard.
Bit of a faff, this one. Nearly there.
longer_wait: This one's taking its sweet time.
Still working. Might be time to put the kettle on.
Taking longer than I'd like. Hang in there.
Bigger job than it looked. Still on it.
Still going. Worth the wait, hopefully.
handoff: On it. I've handed that to a helper and I'll tell you when it lands.
That's with a helper now. I'll shout when it lands.
Delegated. Carry on, I'll flag it when it's done.
Passed to a helper. You'll hear from me when it's sorted.
Right, a helper's on that. I'll let you know when it's in.
Handed off. Kettle on, I'll report back.
job_failed: Bad news, that one didn't make it.
No luck with that one, I'm afraid.
didnt_catch: Didn't catch that. Yes or no?
Sorry, was that a yes or a no?
greet_late: Burning the midnight oil, I see.
I'm here if you need me.
Shouldn't you be asleep? Anyway, I'm here.
greet_morning: What are we working on today?
Fresh day, fresh chaos. Where do we start?
greet_evening: Still at it? Admirable. What's next?
